newsitem.title: USA: EquiMed buys two practices for $4.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: EquiMed buys two practices for $4.4 mln.

text.p: EquiMed Inc said Thursday it had bought two oncology practices during the first quarter for a combined total of $4.4 million.
The company said it paid $3.3 million in cash and $1.1 million in notes payable for the practices of Dr. Joseph Won in Detroit, Michigan and Dr. Mahdu Mohan in Washington, D.C.
The acquisition of the practices, which had combined 1996 net revenues of $4.0 million, brought the number of EquiMed medical and radiation oncology centers to 39, it said.
"We will continue pursuing similar strategic acquisitions to further establish EquiMed as a leader in oncology care," it added.
On April 15, EquiMed said it would not file its annual report with the Securities and Exchange Commission on time because it was not able to get information on a unit sold to another company.
EquiMed is a medical practice management services and out- sourcing company.
